subject: S20 fixes a remount in notes/ReaderNotes.tsx (ReaderNotesLayout): the article moved between a wrapper and a fragment when the side-panel breakpoint was crossed
body:
Found by the S20 video e2e: useSidePanel() flipping (Playwright's fullPage screenshot in Chromium; an iPad rotation or window resize for real) rendered the article in a different tree position, so the whole section remounted and anything stateful in the page reset (a playing video went back to its facade; ink canvas and highlight state too). ReaderNotesLayout now always renders
{article}
{side && open ?
: null}
and shows the PaperSheet only when !side, so the article keeps one position. No behaviour change otherwise (same classes, same panel, same sheet). Landing with S20's next integrate; tell me if you object.
